visual.general_description: Grayscale axial computed tomography slice of the abdomen of a small trunk with a black arrow pointing at the abdominal soft tissue.
visual.detailed_description: A grayscale axial cross-section of a small trunk fills most of the frame on a black background. The spine and vertebral body are at the bottom centre, with curved bright rib or posterior bony margins on both sides near the bottom. A large, grainy, mildly heterogeneous soft-tissue organ occupies most of the abdomen, with brighter vessel-like or contrast-like spots scattered through it and a darker region to the right of centre. A solid black arrow enters from the left edge and points rightward at the soft tissue left of centre. A short white horizontal bar lies below the body near the bottom right. No letters, numbers, panel labels, axis or other text are visible.
